fullPassage: For many of us, making time for exercise is a continuing challenge. Between work commitments and family obligations, it often feels like there's no room in our packed schedules for a dedicated workout. But what if the workout came to you, right in the midst of your daily routine? That's where the beauty of integrating mini-exercises into household chores comes into play. Let's be realistic; chores are inevitable. Whether it's washing dishes or taking out the trash, these tasks are an essential part of daily life. But rather than viewing chores as purely obligatory activities, why not seize these moments as opportunities for physical activity? For instance, practice squats or engage in some wall push-ups as you wait for your morning kettle to boil. Incorporating quick exercises into your daily chores can improve your health.

Let's be realistic; chores are (A)[avoidable / inevitable]. Whether it's washing dishes or taking out the trash, these tasks are an (B)[essential / trivial] part of daily life. But rather than viewing chores as purely obligatory activities, why not seize these moments as opportunities for physical activity? For instance, practice squats or engage in some wall push-ups as you wait for your morning kettle to boil. Incorporating quick exercises into your daily chores can (C)[improve / harm] your health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) inevitable=피할 수 없는, (B) essential=필수적인, (C) improve=개선하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① inevitable — essential — improve — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② avoidable(피할 수 있는): (A) inevitable의 반의어 — '집안일은 불가피하다'와 모순
❌ ③ trivial(사소한): (B) essential의 반의어 — 집안일이 일상의 '필수' 부분이라는 문맥과 모순
❌ ④ harm(해치다): (C) improve의 반의어 — 건강을 '개선한다'는 결론과 모순
det.tip: inevitable(피할 수 없는) ↔ avoidable, essential(필수적인) ↔ trivial, improve(개선하다) ↔ harm

❌ ④ optional(선택적인): (C) obligatory의 반의어 — 집안일을 순전히 '의무적' 활동으로 본다는 문맥과 모순
det.tip: continuing(계속되는) ↔ temporary, dedicated(전용의) ↔ casual, obligatory(의무적인) ↔ optional

det.korean: integrate → integrating. 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: the beauty of ___ 구조에서 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사나 동명사가 와야 함. integrate(동사: 접목하다) → integrating(동명사). '집안일에 미니 운동을 접목하는 것의 아름다움'

questions.passage: For instance, practice squats or engage in some wall push-ups as you wait for your morning kettle to boil. __________ (incorporate) quick exercises into your daily chores can improve your health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: incorporate → Incorporating. 문장의 주어 자리에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: ___ quick exercises ... can improve 구조에서 동사 can improve의 주어가 필요. 동사 incorporate(포함시키다)를 동명사 Incorporating으로 바꿔 주어로 만듦. '집안일에 짧은 운동을 포함시키는 것은 ~할 수 있다'
det.tip: 문장 맨 앞 주어 = 동명사(-ing). incorporate → Incorporating

questions.passage: For many of us, making time for exercise is a continuing challenge. Between work commitments and family obligations, it often feels like there's no room in our packed schedules for a dedicated workout. But what if the workout came to you, right in the midst of your daily routine? That's where the beauty of integrating mini-exercises into household chores comes into play. Let's be realistic; chores are inevitable. Whether it's washing dishes or taking out the trash, these tasks are an essential part of daily life. But rather than viewing chores as purely obligatory activities, why not seize these moments as __________? For instance, practice squats or engage in some wall push-ups as you wait for your morning kettle to boil. Incorporating quick exercises into your daily chores can improve your health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 집안일을 순전히 의무로 보는 대신, 그 순간을 '신체 활동의 기회(opportunities for physical activity)'로 삼자
det.analysis:
✅ ① opportunities for physical activity(신체 활동의 기회): 뒤의 squats·wall push-ups 예시와 연결 ←정답
❌ ② reasons to avoid all effort(모든 노력을 피할 이유): 글의 주장과 반대
❌ ③ excuses for skipping housework(집안일을 건너뛸 핑계): 문맥 부적절
❌ ④ times for social gatherings(사교 모임 시간): 문맥 부적절
det.tip: seize these moments as opportunities for physical activity

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글의 핵심은 '집안일에 미니 운동을 접목하는 것(integrating mini-exercises into household chores)'의 가치
det.analysis:
❌ ① hiring a personal fitness trainer(개인 트레이너 고용): 언급 없음
❌ ② joining an expensive gym club(비싼 헬스장 등록): 글의 취지와 반대
✅ ③ integrating mini-exercises into household chores(집안일에 미니 운동 접목): 글 전체의 핵심 ←정답
❌ ④ scheduling a separate daily workout(별도의 운동 시간 잡기): 따로 시간 낼 필요 없다는 주장과 반대
det.tip: the beauty of integrating mini-exercises into household chores
